title: Исход 28 — Exodus 28
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Позови своего ___ Аарона с его сыновьями.
cases.translation: Summon your brother Aaron with his sons.
cases.explain: Брат is the direct object of позови (call); for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive → брата.

cases.sentence: Из одного материала с ___ и сделанный из золотой нити.
cases.translation: Of one piece with the ephod and made of gold thread.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with / of the same as) takes the instrumental → эфодом.

cases.sentence: Сделай своему ___ Аарону священные одеяния для славы и величия.
cases.translation: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, for glory and honor.
cases.explain: The dative marks the recipient of сделать ("make for your brother") → брату.

cases.sentence: …вырежь на них ___ сыновей Израиля, в порядке их рождения.
cases.translation: …engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel, in the order of their birth.
cases.explain: Имена is the direct object of вырежь (engrave); for this inanimate neuter plural the accusative equals the nominative → имена.

cases.sentence: Вырежь имена ___ Израиля на двух камнях.
cases.translation: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones.
cases.explain: Possession ("the names of the sons") is expressed by the genitive plural → сыновей.

cases.sentence: …прикрепи их к ___ Эфода, как памятные камни для сыновей Израиля.
cases.translation: …attach them to the shoulder straps of the ephod, as memorial stones for the sons of Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / onto) takes the dative → наплечникам (dative plural).

cases.sentence: Аарон будет носить их имена на ___, как памятный знак перед Господом.
cases.translation: Aaron will bear their names on his shoulders, as a memorial before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → плечах (prepositional plural).

cases.translation: …with a blue cord joining the breastplate to the band.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → поясом.

reading.ru: Сделай своему брату Аарону священные одеяния для славы и величия.
reading.question: Why were the holy garments to be made for Aaron?
reading.explain: The garments were to be made for Aaron for glory and honor (dignity).

reading.ru: Нагрудник, эфот, верхнее одеяние, тканный халат, тюрбан и пояс.
reading.question: Which of these was among the garments to be made?
reading.explain: The listed garments include a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a tunic, a turban, and a sash.

reading.ru: Возьми два оникса и вырежь на них имена сыновей Израиля, в порядке их рождения.
reading.question: What was to be engraved on the two onyx stones?
options: The names of the sons of Israel
reading.correct: The names of the sons of Israel
reading.explain: The names of the sons of Israel were to be engraved on the two onyx stones in birth order.

reading.ru: Аарон будет носить их имена на плечах, как памятный знак перед Господом».
reading.question: How was Aaron to carry the names of the sons of Israel?
options: On his shoulders, as a memorial before the Lord
On a scroll around his neck
reading.correct: On his shoulders, as a memorial before the Lord
reading.explain: Aaron was to bear their names on his shoulders as a memorial before the Lord.

reading.ru: Камней должно быть двенадцать, по одному на каждое из имен сыновей Израиля.
reading.question: How many stones were to be set, and why?
options: Twelve, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel
Twenty, for the tribes and elders
reading.correct: Twelve, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel
reading.explain: There were to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel.

reading.ru: Так Аарон всегда будет носить у сердца орудие суда для израилетян перед Господом.
reading.question: What would Aaron always bear over his heart before the Lord?
options: The means of judgment for the Israelites
reading.correct: The means of judgment for the Israelites
reading.explain: Aaron was always to bear the instrument of judgment for the Israelites over his heart before the Lord.
